If the forward fails and it bounces back to our warehouse, tell me and I'll have it sent to your current address, no charge.

Perfect, (address hidden) is what's on it, so the 40T will go there on October 31.

Keep an eye on that forwarded parcel over the next few days. If it stalls or turns back, just reply here with the tracking number and I'll get a fresh one out to (address hidden).
Before you go, one thing: what made you add the Overclocking kit to the NerdOctaxe?

Fair enough, and a spare kit is never wasted. Thanks for telling me, it helps us word that page better.

Enjoy the NerdOctaxe, and the 40T when it lands in (address hidden) on October 31.
